availability.note: CarExpert MY26 variant page: 30e (2.0L petrol + electric) 'released to the Australian market on 3rd July 2026', MLRP $107,700. CarExpert's 2026 X3 listing shows one PHEV variant alongside 20 xDrive, 20d and M50; CarsGuide 2026 price page lists no other PHEV grade. BMW AU site returned 503 to WebFetch twice; a curl probe was refused by a permission check and not retried.

listPrice.note: CarExpert MLRP 'prices starting at $107,700' (before on-road costs; driveaway shown separately as $115,203 Sydney). Agrees with CarsGuide 2026 MSRP $107,700 excl. stamp duty/government charges (https://www.carsguide.com.au/bmw/x-models/price/2026/x3-30e-xdrive-phev) and EV Central $107,700 plus on-roads (marked estimated, updated 21 Nov 2026). Up $2,900 from held $104,800. Manufacturer's own price not reachable (bmw.com.au 503).

batteryKwh.note: usable: 22.7 kWh gross / 19.7 kWh usable (Auto Express UK); ADAC 08/25+ entry lists 19.7 net; CarExpert AU 22.1 max / 19.7 usable

rangeKm.note: ADAC WLTP electric range for current build (from 08/25) 30e M Sportpaket xDrive; same 86 km on the plain and M Sportpaket Pro entries. ADAC lists 245/50R19; the AU MY26 car ships on staggered 20-inch (CarExpert), so the local car may sit lower in BMW's 81-90 km band. AU 'up to 91km ADR' (CarExpert review, CarsGuide) equals the 2024 19-inch WLTP best case (Auto Express 91 km on 19-inch) and is rejected as a best-case figure. Held 85.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm × 100 = 19.7 / 86 × 100 = 22.9. Cross-check: ADAC Ecotest 22.5 kWh/100km; 11/24 ADAC entry WLTP 22.3 kWh/100km. ADAC's 16.2 on the 08/25 entry is a weighted figure, not used.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: WLTP charge-sustaining ('Verbrauch bei entladener Batterie') 7.7 L/100km, 08/25+ M Sportpaket. Earlier build 7.2 (ADAC 335995); Auto Express 37.2 mpg CS (7.6); ADAC Ecotest hybrid mode 8.1. Held 7.6.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Australian combined label 1.6 L/100km claimed (CarExpert; CarsGuide review also 1.6) <= 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km. CarExpert MY26 page: 38 g/km combined.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: '460 L seats up, to window line' = cargo-cover convention; PHEV figure (petrol X3 570 L). ADAC and Auto Express agree.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 1600 L folded (BMW figure via ADAC, Auto Express, CarExpert). ADAC files it as 'dachhoch' (to the roof) and publishes no belt-line folded figure; no review to-cover figure found. Kept as BMW's figure, matching how siblings bmw-x1-phev and mercedes-glc-phev use maker folded figures.

seats.note: two front plus rear seating capacity 3

towKg.note: 2,000 kg braked / 750 unbraked (CarExpert AU MY26); ADAC 2,000 kg braked (12%)

warrantyYears.note: 60 months, unlimited km; battery 72 months / 100,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored between mercedes-glc-phev ($99,900, 2500), volvo-xc60-phev-ultra-t8 ($101,990, 2400), audi-q5-phev-sportback ($100,318, 2500) and bmw-ix3-50-xdrive ($112,500, 2900)

depreciationCurve.note: owner convention: one depreciation curve per brand, matched to bmw-ix3 (2026-11-26). Replaces held steeper [1,0.7,0.58,0.49,0.42,0.36]; no BMW-specific evidence found to keep a separate PHEV curve, and the MY26 change was a list rise, not cuts.

lowConfidence: bmw-x3-phev-30e-xdrive.rangeKm: 86 km WLTP is ADAC's 19-inch figure; the AU car ships on staggered 20-inch tyres and may sit nearer the 81 km floor of BMW's band; no 20-inch WLTP figure found
